model: Zeppelin LZ126 Los Angeles GMT Z85963 (8596-3)
note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. Plan sizes from the trace (42 mm case, listing; strap 21.27 mm measured, not listed). Heights before the house depth scale. Dial print, GMT ring, embossed world map, date window and the strap leather come from one photo map.

case.note: (r, z): polished flank rounding into the wide sloped polished bezel (19.46-21 mm in the photo); inner lip covers the dial edge

crown.note: fluted onion crown: collar, flutes, domed end

strap.note: House curl (SUR419P1): bend at the lug tips, 7 mm radius, end_y = tip + 2.2 x radius

hand_black.note: black hands, seconds counterweight and hub (photo)
